performance.name: performance-baseline-fresh

RSS is sampled, not peak or retained heap.

rollback: Revert the complete Pi manifest/lock, boundary adapters and bundled runtime together. Preserve canonical input, raw tool files and usage facts. Decision features remain independently switchable.
knownLimitations: Earlier refreshed cross-drive smoke reports failed the 3000 ms navigation budget. Final same-drive reports and their individual outcomes are recorded separately; diagnostic repeats are not performance passes.
Original baseline lives on E:, and a second clean baseline was built on C: alongside the upgrade worktree. Cache/run-order/background activity still limit causal or universal performance claims.
Smoke workload: 6 sessions, sizes 20/100/500, two warm repeats, 30 deltas, 3 second soak. No long-duration or 5000-message performance guarantee.
Real provider/OAuth network behavior, classifier quality/cost gains, macOS/Linux and Windows temporary-image ACLs remain unverified.
Windows process script tools still fail closed without a supported filesystem/network isolation backend.
No main merge, push, PR, install, product version bump, signing or release was performed.
